title: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire
hook: OXFORD IS OLDER THAN THE AZTECS
voiceover: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire. Students were studying at Oxford in 1096. The Aztec Empire wasn't founded until 1345. By the time the Aztecs began building their first city, Oxford had been training scholars for over 250 years. By the time the Aztecs fell to the Spanish in 1521, Oxford had been around for over four centuries. We treat the Aztecs like ancient history. But a European university outlived their entire civilization. And Oxford is still operating today. Our timelines for what feels old are completely wrong. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
